findings.motion: Concur in Senate changes, HB 958 Election Law Changes (roll call 801), result 62 to 47
findings.note: On the House concurrence vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes, the legislature's own vote list shows this member voting No. The ratified bill requires a county board to process a registration only if the applicant states citizenship, adds a citizenship question and a perjury statement for incomplete forms, and sets a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It does not change the photo ID rules for voting. Page also shows a Governor's veto of HB 958.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading (roll call 758), result 66 to 47
findings.note: On second reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes, the legislature's vote list shows this member voting No. The same bill carries the citizenship-on-registration and removal-of-flagged-voters provisions described in the ratified text.

findings.motion: HB 958 A1 Blackwell amendment, second reading
findings.note: Voted yes on amendment A1 (Blackwell) to HB 958; passed 112-0. HB 958 (Election Law Changes) as shown on the bill page includes sections on photo identification and provisional ballots, ID with returned absentee ballots, and voter registration applications indicating lack of citizenship. The roll call page does not say what this particular motion changes.
subjects: photo ID at the polls (provisional ballot without ID)
